{{MissingInfo|1|java}} [[File:Sara Lee.png|thumb|250px|Sara Lee]] '''Sara Lee''' (Japanese: '''シン・リー''' ''Cyn Lee'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is a [[Pokémon Performer]]. ==History== [[File:Sara Lee and Concetta SM.png|thumb|220px|Sara Lee and Concetta in Kanto]] Sara Lee first appeared in ''[[XY101|A Dancing Debut!]]'', where she was seen participating in the [[Couriway Town]] [[Pokémon Showcase]] Rookie Class. She gained enough audience votes in the Theme Performance to advance to the Freestyle Performance, but ultimately lost to [[Jessie|Jessilee]]. In ''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]'', Sara Lee competed in the {{ci|Fleurrh}} Showcase Rookie Class, but this time, she did not make it past the Theme Performance. In ''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]'', Sara Lee competed in the Pokémon Showcase Master Class in [[Gloire City]]. In the first round, she went up against {{an|Serena}} and [[Miette]]. Her performance didn't get enough votes from the audience, however, and she ended up being ranked third in the group. She appeared alongside [[Concetta]] in the [[Poké Problem]] segment of ''[[SM043|When Regions Collide!]]'', where they were shown wearing casual clothes and carrying their luggage at an airport in [[Kanto]]. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Sara Lee's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sara Lee |pkmn=Glaceon |type1=Ice |img=Sara Lee Glaceon.png |epnum=XY101 |epname=A Dancing Debut! |desc={{p|Glaceon}} first appeared in ''[[XY101|A Dancing Debut!]]'', where it was seen participating in the {{to|Couriway}} {{pkmn|Showcase}} Rookie Class with its Trainer and Leafeon. The three of them managed to advance to the Freestyle Performance, where they ultimately lost to [[Jessie|Jessilee]] with her {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}} and {{TP|Jessie|Gourgeist}}. It reappeared in ''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]'', where it was seen backstage with its Trainer, watching {{an|Serena}} participate in the Theme Performance at the {{ci|Fleurrh}} Showcase Rookie Class. Glaceon and its Trainer did not make it past the Theme Performance this time. Glaceon appeared once again in ''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]'', where it competed in the {{ci|Gloire}} Showcase Master Class with its Trainer. In the first round, they went up against {{an|Serena}} and her {{TP|Serena|Braixen}}, and [[Miette]] and her {{p|Slurpuff}}. Their performance didn't get enough votes from the audience, however, and Glaceon and its Trainer were ranked third in the group. It reappeared yet again in the [[Poké Problem]] segment of [[SM043]], where it and its Trainer were standing in an airport in [[Kanto]]. Glaceon's known moves are {{m|Attract}} and {{m|Ice Beam}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sara Lee |pkmn=Leafeon |type1=Grass |img=Sara Lee Leafeon.png |epnum=XY101 |epname=A Dancing Debut! |desc={{p|Leafeon}} made its only appearance in ''[[XY101|A Dancing Debut!]]'', where it was seen participating in the [[Couriway Town]] [[Pokémon Showcase]] Rookie Class with its Trainer and Glaceon. The three of them won their Theme Performance and advanced to the Freestyle Performance, where they ultimately lost to [[Jessie|Jessilee]] with her {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}} and {{TP|Jessie|Gourgeist}}. Leafeon's only known move is {{m|Attract}}.}} ==Showcases== ===Princess Keys obtained=== This listing is of the {{DL|Pokémon Showcase|Princess Key}}s Sara Lee has obtained: * At least three Princess Keys (prior to ''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]'') ===Master Class ranking=== Sara Lee has achieved the following ranking in the Master Class tournament: * {{ci|Gloire}} Showcase - {{tt|Top 28|Round 1, third in her individual group}} (''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]'') ===Other achievements=== Sara Lee has competed in the following Rookie Class tournaments: * {{to|Couriway}} Showcase - Top 5 (''[[XY101|A Dancing Debut!]]'') * {{ci|Fleurrh}} Showcase - Theme Performance (''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{ice color}}|bordercolor={{grass color}} |ja= |en=[[Kate Bristol]] |fr_eu=Delphine Chauvier |fi=Amy Burgess}} ==Trivia== * Sara's hairstyle and attire are modeled after her Leafeon and Glaceon.
